scripts.text:
[ Edict of the Divine Rune-Midgarts Kingdom ]
 
1. Follow the ordinance of The Divine Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, 
We declare that
there is no formal master of this castle.
 
2. To the one who can 
overcome all trials
and destroy the Emperium,
the king will endow the one with
ownership of this castle.
scripts.translation:
[神聖盧恩·米德加茲王國敕令]

1. 依照神聖盧恩·米德加茲王國法令，茲宣佈此城堡尚無正式領主。

2. 凡通過所有試煉並摧毀華麗金屬者，國王將授予其城堡所有權。

scripts.text:
[ Echoing Voice ]
Brave ones...
Do you wish to return to your honorable place?
scripts.translation:
[迴盪的聲音]
勇士們...
你們是否要返回屬於你們的榮耀之地？
